messages:
Sam: quick pass — we need final copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private pages by EOD so dev can wire CTAs. I pushed a doc (internal) but putting quick proposals here.
Priya: TY. can we prioritize the funnel for Hosted->Self-serve signup first? That page drives trial signups. Dedicated should push contact/quote. Private needs security-first messaging and gated leads.
Liam: Agreed. For Hosted: lightweight hero, social proof, then 2 CTAs (Start free / See benchmarks). For Dedicated: 'Get predictable throughput' + Contact sales CTA.
Teresa: Couple of short hero variants to A/B — keep them tight.
Teresa: ```
Hosted hero A: "Hosted API — production-grade LLM inference, instantly."
Hosted hero B: "Ship LLM features fast — low latency, clear pricing."
Dedicated hero A: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable inference."
Dedicated hero B: "Dedicated throughput, predictable unit economics."
Private hero: "Private deployment for regulated workloads — VPC, KMS, audit logs."
```
Priya: Nice. For benchmarks section: callout the 99th perc latency and cost/token for 2048 seq on common models. Use simple two-line bullets and a CTA: 'View full benchmark suite'.
Sam: Also need inbound lead routing rules — hosted trial -> product-led nurture; dedicated -> SDR queue; private -> enterprise AE + security pack email. Teresa could you sketch the form fields for each?
Teresa: Sketch: ```
Hosted form: name, org, email, billing opt-in checkbox
Dedicated: name, org, email, monthly TPS, target models, notes
Private: name, org, email, compliance contact, preferred region, NDA request checkbox
```
Liam: One more ask: add webinar CTA beneath benchmarks: "See our throughput demo" — link to signup modal that tags attendee as intent=performance. marketing-bot: webinar slot scheduled for May 5. Page CTA should route to /webinars/perf-demo?utm_campaign=site_cta
Priya: On page sequencing — hero, quick bullets (latency/cost), benchmark snapshot, customer logos, detailed benefits per product, CTAs. Make sure Dedicated and Private have a prominent 'Contact sales' flow that sets tier in CRM.
Sam: I'll take the hosted hero A copy and Teresa will wire forms. Priya, can you confirm the benchmark numbers in the doc by 3pm? Liam will prepare the webinar link.
Teresa: I'll drop the form JSON to the doc and add a mapping for inbound routing. Example mapping snippet: ```json
{
  "source":"site-contact",
  "product":"dedicated",
  "route":"sdr-queue",
  "priority":"high"
}
```
Priya: Quick thought — swap 'Get predictable throughput' to 'Predictable inference at scale' for tone. small change but tighter.
Sam: love that. final checks: tone: pragmatic, engineering-led, cost+reliability first. No hype. I'll update the doc and ping design for CTA treatment. :thumbsup:
Liam: will add performance demo assets to the doc.
marketing-bot: Reminder: sprint deadline tomorrow 09:00 for site freeze.
Sam: got it — wrapping up in the doc now. Thanks everyone!
